# Jannie Jensen

Jannie Jensen serves as a patient representative (Patientrepræsentant) on the steering committee of [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease[^src1][^src2]. Jensen's role represents patient perspectives within the governance structure of a registry that tracks treatment and outcomes for thousands of Danish patients with inflammatory bowel disease across all five Danish regions.

DANIBD's steering committee is composed of representatives from medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation across Denmark, along with epidemiological and data management support from RKKP[^src3]. The database, which covers patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treated at public Danish hospitals, documented treatment of 33,381 patients during the period from October 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023, with biologic treatments (BMSL) administered to 10,523 of those patients[^src3].
